normalize_L2: L2 normalize a torch tensor along a specified dimension
create_get_rmac_region_coordinates: create RMAC region coordinates for image dimensions H, W with L levels
build_get_rmac_descriptors: build RMAC descriptors from feature maps with optional PCA and L2 normalization
test_get_rmac_region_coordinates: test get_rmac_region_coordinates with image height 224, width 224, and 3 levels
run_get_rmac_descriptors: run get_rmac_descriptors on a batch of feature tensors with RMAC levels and PCA
